question: In January 2025, India Open badminton tournament was held in ____.
solution:
The correct answer is __**New Delhi**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 
• The **India Open badminton tournament** is one of the most prestigious badminton tournaments held annually in India. 
• In **January 2025**, the tournament was hosted in the **capital city of India, New Delhi**. 
• The event is part of the **BWF World Tour**, attracting top international players from across the globe. 
• **New Delhi**, being a well-connected and prominent city, has world-class sports infrastructure suitable for hosting events of this magnitude. 
• The venue used for the India Open typically includes facilities like the **K.D. Jadhav Indoor Hall**, which is known for hosting badminton tournaments and other sporting events.
